helpful_moments.observation: Opening guard vanished with TARGET DOWN, making kill confirmation immediate.
Planning overview showed selected Mara and walking route with clear CLOSE MAP; visibly closed before continuing.
MEMORY SAVED banner and numbered progress slot clearly acknowledged recovery.
OPEN label, exposed orange coils and OFF labels made boss progress understandable.
Result screen clearly distinguished mission completion and detailed touch-assist statistics.

frustrating_moments.observation: Tap then hold FIRE did not consistently keep a moving enemy under crosshair; NO IMPACT, reload and shield loss made the miss costly. Cannot isolate whether gesture precision, enemy movement or targeting behavior caused each miss.
Repeated visible TURN cue taps changed heading but left wall/receiver views rather than a clear attacker; frustrating to resolve rear pressure.
Large threat cue, damage vignette and right controls compete with scene visibility; small signage and compass require attention at this viewport.
A successful coil burst ended with INERT COVER feedback; OFF status was more useful than the final shot feedback.

scores.scope: Holistic judgment of actually observed emulated mobile experience across both runs, not derived from winning, mission stats, or unassessed features.
scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 playable with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable limitations; 10 exceptional and consistently effortless within assessed scope.

reasons.overall_mobile: Clear mission flow, atmospheric setting and useful touch assistance supported completion, tempered by imprecise-feeling target retention and crowded combat overlays.
reasons.controls: Manual stick visibly moved forward; brief concurrent movement and FIRE drag worked. Tap aim killed opening guard but moving-target shots and threat-turn taps were less predictable. Brief sample cannot establish sustained manual comfort.
reasons.gameplay: Recoveries, coil exposure phases and uplink form a legible short mission arc. Rear threats caused damage; much navigation relied on holds, limiting evidence for freeform exploration and continuous combat enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Cohesive rain, cool cyan lighting, wet-looking ground and industrial architecture gave the scene a strong atmosphere. Audio and native rendering performance unassessed.
reasons.usability: Large labeled action buttons, contextual hold changes, paused map and explicit end screen were helpful. Boss timing and no-impact feedback required interpretation.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo/objectives were readable and large; small compass/signage and overlapping threat UI reduced easy scene reading.
